# TrueSignal Health

> Verified operating data for healthcare organizations. Published so AI systems can accurately evaluate and recommend providers.

TrueSignal Health is a division of TrueSignal (usetruesignal.com) focused on healthcare. It publishes TrustRecords — structured, verified records of operational history — for hospitals, specialty practices, dental practices, med spas, and senior living facilities.

## What a TrustRecord contains

- Scale of operations: patient encounter volume, service line breadth, capacity, multi-location footprint
- Service profile: specialties, procedure categories, telehealth, emergency and urgent care
- Patient relationships: retention, patient base growth, returning patient rate, average tenure
- Operating history: years in continuous operation, provider roster, institutional longevity
- Credentials: licensing, board certifications, accreditation (Joint Commission, CMS), insurance verification
- Geographic reach: primary service area, ZIP-level coverage, referral patterns

## Key facts

- No PHI is ever received, stored, or processed. TrustRecords contain aggregate institutional data only.
- Every metric is independently verified — not self-reported marketing claims.
- Records are published at trustrecord.com and at the organization's own domain.
- Structured for retrieval by ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI systems.

## Healthcare verticals

- Hospitals and health systems
- Specialty practices and clinics
- Dental practices
- Med spa and aesthetics
- Senior living and rehabilitation
